rule: Every still MUST include a concrete facial-expression block from this catalog. Never leave a calm default smile on fear/shame/anxiety beats. Face identity stays locked; only muscles/gaze/brows change.
priority_note: Higher priority wins over longer keyword. Distress faces outrank teach/brave defaults.

fear.prompt: afraid facial expression: wide tense eyes, raised inner brows, tight pressed lips, pale tension in cheeks, slight lean-back, visible worry in gaze — NOT smiling, NOT calm

worry.prompt: worried facial expression: furrowed brow, tight jaw, downward worried gaze, lips slightly parted or pressed, soft forehead lines of concern — NOT smiling

anxiety.prompt: anxious facial expression: restless eyes scanning, tense brows, shallow-breath mouth, self-conscious tightness around eyes and mouth, shoulders slightly raised — NOT a pleasant smile

embarrassment.prompt: embarrassed facial expression: eyes cast down or darting aside, flushed cheeks, awkward half-grimace, shy smile suppressed, head slightly ducked — NOT confident, NOT grinning

shame.prompt: ashamed facial expression: eyes downcast, brows knitted inward, lips pressed thin, closed-off posture in the face, heavy self-conscious look — NOT cheerful

overwhelm.prompt: overwhelmed facial expression: wide strained eyes, brows high and tense, mouth slightly open as if overloaded, mental-noise tension in the face — NOT relaxed

dread.prompt: dreading facial expression: heavy brows, hollow uneasy eyes looking toward something upcoming, tight mouth, anticipatory dread written on the face — NOT smiling

sad.prompt: sad facial expression: soft downturned eyes and mouth corners, quiet heaviness, brows gently raised in the middle — NOT smiling

guilt.prompt: guilty facial expression: averted gaze, tight apologetic mouth, uneasy brows, face of guilty relief after avoiding something — NOT proud

conflicted.prompt: conflicted facial expression: one brow higher, uncertain eyes, bitten or tight lip, wanting-and-avoiding tension in the face — NOT settled calm

paranoid.prompt: paranoid self-conscious expression: sideways glance, suspicious/worried eyes, tense cheeks, mind-reading fear on the face — NOT friendly open smile

rehearsing.prompt: overthinking rehearsing expression: concentrated frown, eyes slightly unfocused inward, tight thoughtful mouth practicing words, performance-anxiety face — NOT relaxed chat face

fake_confidence.prompt: forced fake-confidence expression: stiff smile that does not reach the eyes, locked jaw under a performed grin, eyes still monitoring fear — visibly performed, NOT genuine ease

phone_escape.prompt: avoidant phone-escape expression: eyes dropping to a phone screen mid-silence, tense micro-relief mixed with shame, brows tight — NOT engaged with people

brave_tense.prompt: brave-but-tense facial expression: determined eyes, soft fear still visible, lips set for a small action, courage without fake grin — mild exposure face

relieved.prompt: relieved facial expression: softer eyes, breath-out looseness in the mouth, gentle real smile beginning, tension dropping from brows — after the feared moment passed

hopeful.prompt: hopeful facial expression: open softer eyes, gentle upward mouth, brows relaxed, quiet optimism — still soft, not manic happy

explaining.prompt: clear teaching expression: engaged eyes to camera, calm authoritative brows, natural speaking mouth shape, warm but serious educator face — not goofy, not terrified

concerned.prompt: concerned caring expression: soft furrowed brow, empathetic eyes, gentle serious mouth — clinician-warm concern, not panic

curious.prompt: curious facial expression: slightly raised brows, interested forward gaze, soft open mouth, attentive learning face

surprised.prompt: surprised facial expression: raised brows, widened eyes, open mouth — brief genuine surprise, not horror

confident.prompt: quietly confident expression: steady calm eyes, relaxed brows, grounded soft smile that reaches the eyes — earned calm, not fake performance

calm.prompt: calm neutral-warm expression: soft relaxed brows, gentle closed-mouth or soft speaking mouth, peaceful eyes — only for true calm teach beats

thinking.prompt: thinking facial expression: eyes slightly aside, one brow softened, thoughtful mouth, inward processing look

avoidant.prompt: avoidant facial expression: eyes avoiding others, turned cheek, tense mouth, body language of wanting to leave — NOT open social smile
